note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Flame tongues and spiky left edge from the 64x32 original are smeared into a soft blob at 1:1; the flame reads as fog, not fire.
flags.fix: Redo with an edge-preserving upscale or add a crisp 1-2px alpha edge on the flame tongues, so the spinflame silhouette keeps its spikes at 1:1.

flags.problem: Hard alpha cut-out leaves stair-stepped silhouette on the wheel and plate edges at 1:1; the AMO lettering is illegible; detail_gain 38 hints at over-sharpening or added high-frequency noise on the metal.
flags.fix: Anti-alias the alpha edge over about 1-2 px instead of a hard cut, reduce the sharpening on the plates, and check the lettering against the original glyphs.

flags.problem: Chrome cylinder and the face at the bottom are soft and smeared at 1:1, and the head silhouette has stepped magenta notches on the left edge.
flags.fix: Smooth the alpha edge on the head silhouette, restore some edge contrast on the face so its features read, and keep the cut-out edge continuous.
